{{Short description|Instance of Munster Hurling championship}} {{one source|date=December 2021}} {{Use Hiberno-English|date=December 2021}} {{Use dmy dates|date=December 2021}} {{Infobox GAA championship |image = |name = Munster Senior Hurling Championship |county = |province = Munster |year = 2021 |trophy = The Munster Cup |sponsor = |date = 27 June – 18 July 2021 |num_teams = 5 |defending_champions = [[Limerick county hurling team|Limerick]] |winners = [[Limerick county hurling team|Limerick]] |ordinal = 22 |manager = [[John Kiely (Limerick hurler)|John Kiely]] |captain = [[Declan Hannon]] |qualify_for = [[2021 Munster Senior Hurling Championship Final|Munster SHC Final]]
[[2021 All-Ireland Senior Hurling Championship|All-Ireland SHC]] |runnersup = [[Tipperary county hurling team|Tipperary]] |runnerupmanager = [[Liam Sheedy]] |runnerupcaptain = [[Séamus Callanan]] |promoted = |relegated = |matches = 4 |total_scored = |poty = |topscorer = |website = |previous = [[2020 Munster Senior Hurling Championship|2020]] |next = [[2022 Munster Senior Hurling Championship|2022]] }} The '''2021 Munster Senior Hurling Championship''' was the 134th staging of the [[Munster Senior Hurling Championship]] since its establishment by the [[Gaelic Athletic Association]] in [[1888 All-Ireland Senior Hurling Championship#Munster Senior Hurling Championship|1888]]. Limerick were the twice-[[2020 Munster Senior Hurling Championship|defending Munster champions]]. They won the title for the 3rd year in succession, defeating Tipperary in the final.{{cite web |title=Immense second-half turnaround sees Limerick deny Tipperary in Munster final |url=https://www.echolive.ie/corksport/arid-40339985.html |website=Echo Live |access-date=13 December 2021}} ==Teams== The Munster championship was contested by five of the six counties from the Irish province of [[Munster]].
